summary: Independent implementation review of the actual current implementation context 404ced22, subject b8cc97c55c872c3435b241f5f4f38f519392ed4e, frozen spec fbde450e and V2 snapshot cc95b020. The three governed production changes remain limited to binary event append on Windows and explicit Git --no-optional-locks in the two read-only collectors. Canonical UTF-8 plus one LF, existing prefix bytes, error handling, timeouts, inherited environment and full snapshot/index rejection semantics remain intact. Separately authored facts/Git/resource-bundle tests are safe companions and transport, not additional DU-001 production scope. The wheel fixture excludes only exact top-level distribution uv_cache.json; normal package files still require hash/size validation and nested metadata remains rejected. Previously inspected Windows red/green diagnostics support the specific regressions. For the actual sole A09 native run, independently inspected evidence db536029 is passed in pre_implementation_review phase: all 14 required checks passed through the original eight execution groups, the shared full suite reported 6510 passed and 9 explicitly reported skips in 2378.23 seconds within its unchanged 3000-second limit, core/analysis total coverage was 90/98 percent and the unchanged diff gate passed with 100 percent over two measured core lines and no changed analysis coverage lines. Ruff, format and strict mypy passed; committed whitespace inspection was clean. All five original mutation pairs had baseline exit 0 and mutant exit 1, were killed without timeout or run reason, and retained main_tree_unchanged. The 85 exported originals total 5921542 bytes and match the terminal authenticated after-map and manifest d2791ee3 by every size and SHA256. Native/context receipts preserve all 3636 environment and 2569 source originals, and the evidence bytes are unchanged across fresh context generation. Current reviewed source/test hashes match those native baselines. Old failures, spent actions and original history remain retained. This is the formal implementation review only. It does not assert that the host task has already imported Guest state, nor claim finalization, code approval, a passing Gate, current HEAD Linux required checks, publication or target acceptance. Earlier Linux CI is historical support, not a current-HEAD check. Ordinary direct and sdist-rebuilt wheel acceptance remains a post-Gate step in the frozen serial plan; no conclusion about reusing earlier wheel evidence is made here. Existing platform and Node-material skips are reported, not represented as executed acceptance. No additional tests, Guest execution or CLI recording were performed by this reviewer.
